answer: Imagine a comet that returns only after circling the sun once: each agent must carry a vault whose lock is a chain of memory-hard steps, each step carved into shale and sealed by the one before it, and the chain grows longer with every season served. Ten clones cannot share one vault — each must run the whole chain alone, so ten clones pay ten chains yet weigh as one. A single honest keeper tends one vault and keeps what its own seasons earned.
